name: Thornwick Levy-Pikeman
backstory: An indebted peat-cutter conscripted after failing to pay three seasons of bridge-tithe. He knows nothing of swordplay, only that keeping an ash-shaft pointed forward keeps gnolls off his boots.
hire_line: Half upfront, half after supper, and nobody puts me in front of the horses.
quirk: Refuses to cross deep water unless paid a two-copper bonus.

name: Alderwood Poacher
backstory: Missing the tip of her left ear from a magistrate's branding iron after skinning crown venison in Greywood. She treats military service as legal poaching with slightly worse rations.
hire_line: I supply my own goose-feathers; you supply targets that don't shoot back.
quirk: Skims silver rings off corpses before reporting loot totals.

name: Fen-Barbers' Apprentice
backstory: Dismissed from an Oakhaven apothecary guild for diluting laudanum with willow-water to cover gambling debts. His stitches are crooked, his salves stink of mutton fat, yet men survive them.
hire_line: Hold still when I sew and I won't charge extra for clean thread.

hurt: I'm a surgeon, not a shield!

quirk: Drinks cheap gin before every battle to steady his suturing hand.

name: Greywood Timber-Feller
backstory: Lost his logging camp when border raiders burned the timber sledges. He swings a broad felling-axe two-handed and treats armored knights like stubborn oak stumps.
hire_line: Point out the thickest thing breathing and clear room for my backswing.
quirk: Compulsively tests every wooden door and bridge with his axe-poll.

name: Defrocked Lantern-Scribe
backstory: Pawned three temple oil-lamps to pay off a Thornwick tavern tab and fled before the hermit-prior noticed. He knows four volatile fire cantrips and zero restraint.
hire_line: Keep flammable rations three paces behind my elbows and we'll get along.
quirk: Singes his own eyebrows whenever nervous before an ambush.

name: Thornwick Parish Sexton
backstory: Dug graves in Thornwick's flooded churchyard for twelve winters until he realized half the town's debtors died owing him shovel-fees. Now he collects labor directly from the turf.
hire_line: I bury what falls and bill the rest. Keep the corpses intact.
quirk: Measures every mercenary's height with a knotted cord during camp.

name: Alkali Salt-Slinger
backstory: A former salt-pan drover who learned to whip lead-cored sling-stones at dune vipers from forty paces. He joined the army after bandits seized his brine-pans for back taxes.
hire_line: Lead shot is cheap, skulls are brittle, and my canteen's empty.
quirk: Chews bitter alkali root constantly, staining his teeth rust-red.

name: Deep Quarry Sapper
backstory: Escaped three years in Gorrathul's ironstone chains with a heavy miner's pick and a permanent cough. He cracks chitin shells and stone constructs with bitter enthusiasm.
hire_line: Pay me in clean water and iron wedges, and I'll drop any wall you name.
quirk: Refuses to sleep inside stone buildings, fearing roof collapses.

name: Bracken Track-Warden
backstory: Tracked runaway convicts across the Redmarsh flats until the local magistrate stopped paying bounties. She reads sand-drifts like parchment and hates marching in formation.
hire_line: Let me scout twenty paces ahead and you won't step on a single dune lurker.
quirk: Hoards dried lizard jerky inside her quiver.

name: Disgraced Aquifer-Novice
backstory: Cast out of a desert hermitage for tapping a sacred cistern to irrigate his own melon patch. His water-wards keep armored men from cooking alive in Redmarsh heat.
hire_line: Keep steel off my cassock and I'll keep your lungs from turning to dust.
quirk: Blesses every puddle before stepping across it.

name: Third-Dynasty Tomb Notary
backstory: Copied funerary liens for Zahra's expedition until an embalmer's hex left his left hand stiff as dried leather. He settles old desert debts with cold astral ink.
hire_line: Every bandit out here owes tax to a dead king; I merely serve the writ.
quirk: Catalogs every enemy killed on a strip of papyrus tied to his belt.

name: Jawbone Shield-Sergeant
backstory: Sole survivor of a caravan guard butchered in the Twin Passes because the merchant refused to buy extra arrows. He carries a scarred kite shield and trusts nobody with coin.
hire_line: Silver in my palm before we march, and nothing crosses my shield rim.
quirk: Sleeps with his shield strapped to his left forearm.

name: Oakhaven Boarding Marine
backstory: Lost two toes to frostbite on a winter blockade cutter and traded sea-decks for mud trenches. He fights best in tight boarding-crushes where nobody can step backward.
hire_line: Point me at the gangplank and keep rum out of the surgeons' tent.
quirk: Spits over his left shoulder before drawing his cutlass.

name: Seawall Arbalestier
backstory: A former customs tower guard who windlassed heavy steel prods at smugglers' galleys for ten years. Slow to reload, lethal against armored knights and sea-constructs.
hire_line: Give me a dry parapet and three seconds to crank, and I'll punch through hull-plate.
quirk: Files a tiny notch into his stock for every officer dropped.

name: Spire Storm-Channeler
backstory: Expelled from Oakhaven's weather-guild after accidentally frying three prize harbor gulls during a fog-clearing ritual. He treats wet coastal battlefields like copper conductors.
hire_line: Keep iron pikes away from my cuffs when the thunder rolls.
quirk: Wears rubberized boot-soles stolen from a lighthouse keeper.

name: Field Triage Sawbones
backstory: Trained under Chief Healer Sera until his habit of selling amputated trophies to alchemy students got him kicked out of the tent. Fast with a tourniquet and cynical about survival odds.
hire_line: Try to lose limbs cleanly; ragged tears waste half my vinegar.
quirk: Evaluates every ally's collarbone structure upon meeting them.

name: Wreck-Bell Notary
backstory: Witnessed sailors' deathbed wills on the Iron Coast until the drowned began answering his bell without being called. He silences enemy hexers with cold sea-grave authority.
hire_line: The tide keeps every promise made over salt water; let me collect yours.
quirk: Refuses to eat shellfish, claiming they carry drowned sailors' memories.

name: Ironclad Deserter
backstory: Walked off the field at Sundered Ranks when his warlord paid the company in clipped tin coins. He wears scavenged coastal brigandine and fights solely for guaranteed silver.
hire_line: Coin weighs the same under any banner—just make sure yours stays upright.
quirk: Bites every gold coin paid to him before pocketing it.

name: Ironcamp Halberdier
backstory: A scarred caldera veteran whose eyebrows never grew back after the Greystone wall-breach. He hooks demonic champions out of formation with a meteor-slag halberd.
hire_line: Keep my boots oiled against the sulfur and I'll hold the gates of hell.
quirk: Rubs volcanic pumice on his palms before every assault.

name: Caldera Ridge-Marksman
backstory: Hunted redglass drakes on the volcanic crags to harvest wing-splinters for Ironcamp's fletchers. She compensates for thermal updrafts without blinking.
hire_line: Heat shimmer bends arrows, not my aim. Mark the priority target.
quirk: Wears smoked-quartz goggles even inside dark vaults.

name: Vok's Runesmith-Adept
backstory: Trained at Ironcamp's open-fissure foundries to quench white-hot blades with focused frost magic. He freezes magma-armored brutes so infantry can shatter them.
hire_line: Everything in this caldera burns hot; I bring the cold water.
quirk: Carries a chunk of mountain glacier-ice wrapped in oiled felt.

name: Scorched Penitent-Guard
backstory: A former Ember Court tax-bailiff who blinded himself with hot ash after realizing what his levies funded. He marches straight into hellfire without flinching.
hire_line: My debt is paid in scars; let me stand between your company and the flame.
quirk: Counts his own heartbeat aloud whenever standing near magma.

name: First-Watch Debt-Collector
backstory: Archivist of the Threshold catacombs who survived three decades cataloging frozen oaths beneath the obsidian floor. He calls ancient watchmen out of the ash to finish their terms.
hire_line: The First Watch never received their discharge papers; I am here to sign them.
quirk: Polishes brass seal-weights whenever idle.

name: Caldera Siege-Engineer
backstory: Lost three fingers on his left hand rigging blasting charges against the Gauntlet portcullises. He fires packed prism-powder quarrels that crack siege golems open.
hire_line: Keep open flames off my belt and I'll turn their iron golems into gravel.
quirk: Sniffs the wind constantly for sulfur leaks.
